name: The Elder Dragon War
oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — This Saga deals 2 damage to each creature and each opponent.
II — Discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
III — Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
blocked_sentences: Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
III — Create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.

needs.what: Read ahead on a Saga (714.3a/702.155): as the Saga enters, its controller chooses a number from 1 to its final chapter and it enters with that many lore counters; chapter abilities whose chapter number is below the chosen number do not trigger from that initial placement (only the chosen chapter triggers), and normal lore-counter addition and sacrifice-after-final-chapter apply thereafter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `chapter` ability kind and `chapter` trigger event cover ordinary Sagas that enter with one lore counter, but `keywords` has no read_ahead, no card-level key chooses the starting lore count, and `enters_with_additional_counters` is a fixed static amount with no player choice and no suppression of skipped chapter triggers

needs.what: a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has dragon_5_5_r_flying (5/5) only; a 5/5 is not the printed 4/4
